what: same-pool rule-swap control: GLOD-RIS's own selection rule on our exact candidate pools and released components (2026-10-12 operator instruction)
rule: joint = max(DOD,0) * localization * max(category,0), argmax over the semantic top-10. DOD = cos(decoupled fused region feature, expression text) with Eqs. (1)-(7) decoupling (orthogonal residual on the background, area-ratio weight clamped to [mu,tau], raw fusion basis); localization = mean over the mask of the 3x3 cell-centred Gaussian map of the MLLM grid (scale 0.7, normalised to its max); category = cos(fused feature, MLLM category text). All-zero grid -> uniform map; parked guidance -> DOD-only path (no localization/category term). Constants from the paper: grid_size=3, gaussian_scale=0.7, mu=0.3, tau=0.8, top_k=10, fusion_basis=raw, spatial_reduction=mean, score_transform=positive. glod/core.py (decouple, gaussian_map, select_mask) imported verbatim from the reproduction, so the rule is held fixed and only the pool/components differ. expression text = released ensemble 0.5*sentence + 0.5*noun phrase (the same parsed strings the records' released scores use); category text = the MLLM category string, encoded with the same modified_CLIP ViT-B/16. nothing is fitted: no constant, threshold or template was selected on the val splits; the rule is the reproduction's reading of the paper.
guidance_source: GLM-4.1V-Thinking-Flash via the Zhipu API, category + 3x3 grid per expression, read from the completed full-val reproduction cache at /home/msj_team/Jacob/sys/glod_ris_repro/cache/glm (prompt_version glod-independent-v1); no new API calls were needed for these three splits
